bio: The history of this restaurant, a culinary temple for mushroom-lovers, is also one that showcases a love for hospitality, given that chef Elena Lucas represents (with infinite modesty) the third generation of the family to have worked in the kitchen here. Its name is an affectionate tribute to her grandmother (Luciana Lobo) and enables guests to gain a better understanding of her highly personal and creative cuisine which explores time-honoured flavours and champions the local surroundings and their natural bounty.
